user.title: Connect to Zero
user.description: Connect Home Assistant Assist to the independent Zero assistant. Credentials stay private. Use the dedicated voice and settings tokens, never the administrator API key.

reconfigure.title: Connect to Zero
reconfigure.description: Connect Home Assistant Assist to the independent Zero assistant. Credentials stay private. Use the dedicated voice and settings tokens, never the administrator API key.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot read Zero settings. Check the server URL and dedicated settings token.

init.title: Zero prompt and Home Assistant access
init.description: Loaded directly from Zero. Saving updates Zero for all owner conversations, including Telegram and Assist. There is no separate HA prompt. Built-in tool and safety instructions remain managed by Zero. Assist and Frigate also require explicit service names below. Disabling access blocks new owner tool calls; existing reminders remain scheduled.

data.homeAssistant: Allow Zero to use Home Assistant tools
data.assist: Allow delegation to Home Assistant Assist

abort.cannot_connect: Cannot confirm Zero settings. No action was retried. Check the connection and reopen Configure to read current settings.
abort.conflict: Settings changed elsewhere. Reopen Configure before saving.
